column1: # note: RCW 82.87.040(1): seven percent of an individual's Washington capital gains, and from January 1, 2025, a further 2.90 percent of the portion exceeding $1,000,000. Washington prints no tax table.
# note: The rows are on Washington capital gains after the deductions. The second row holds the two rates together: base_tax $70,000 is 7% of $1,000,000 and rate 0.099 is 7% plus 2.9%.
# note: The tax does not depend on filing status; it is repeated for single, married filing jointly and married filing separately, which the return distinguishes.
# note: Neither the statute nor the return rounds the tax to whole dollars; it is taken to the cent.
